input.prompt: Locked-camera 16:9 ambient animation layer for an ORIGINAL colorful cartoon post-apocalyptic tower-defense city map. No characters, no roads, no UI, no text, no logos. Neutral dark transparent-like background substitute: plain near-black background intended for compositing. Animate ONLY isolated environmental effects spread across frame: two small steam puffs rising and dissipating, a few loose papers/leaves drifting slowly, tiny dust motes, one amber hazard beacon blinking gently, subtle wisps of smoke. Motion must be slow, loop-friendly, non-cinematic, no camera movement, no zoom, no scene cuts. Keep effects separated so they can be masked/composited in Unity.
